gaps.sentence: The law was introduced to stop ___ (CHEAT) by companies.
The new software ___ (ABLE) staff to work securely from anywhere.
gaps.explanation: 'Enable somebody to do something' — the present-tense verb fits the singular subject.

gaps.sentence: Her sudden ___ (DIE) shocked the whole village.
gaps.explanation: 'Her sudden death' — 'die' is the verb, 'death' the noun.

gaps.sentence: The council rejected plans for a new ___ (DEVELOP).
gaps.explanation: 'A development' = a building project; 'developer' = the company.

gaps.sentence: She showed great ___ (WISE) in avoiding the deal.
gaps.explanation: 'Wisdom' — the quality noun from wise (spelling: wise → wisdom).

gaps.sentence: The instructions have been ___ (SIMPLE) so that children can follow them.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'have been simplified' — the verb form meaning made simpler.
'Appealed for calm' — the set phrase uses 'calm' as noun.
